title: Inter cannot name the same eleven at Bologna — the papers expect changes
caption: Inter cannot name the same eleven at Bologna. No points from two in the Champions League after the 3–4 at home to Club Brugge. Per Gazzetta dello Sport and Corriere dello Sport, Bisseck, Çalhanoğlu and Thuram all started against Parma and Club Brugge and could sit on Saturday. #Inter #BolognaInter #Chivu https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/tt/?ed=44
